Body.Content:
What and why

We're enhancing Real-Time Alerting rule management in the Microsoft Teams admin center to help administrators manage alerting rules more efficiently and at greater scale.

With this update, administrators will be able to:

  • Duplicate existing rules to create similar alert configurations without manually recreating them.
  • Bulk upload users when creating or editing rules, reducing manual effort when monitoring larger groups of users.
  • Delete rules directly from the management experience to simplify rule maintenance and cleanup.

These enhancements are designed to streamline administration of Real-Time Alerting rules and improve operational efficiency.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in late September 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Microsoft Teams administrators who configure and manage Real-Time Alerting rules in the Teams admin center.

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams
  • Teams admin center

What will happen

The following capabilities will become available in the Teams admin center under Notifications & alerts > Rules:

  • Administrators can duplicate existing Real-Time Alerting rules.
  • Administrators can bulk upload users while creating or editing supported rules.
  • Administrators can delete rules directly from the rule management experience.
  • Organizations can monitor up to 500 users across their Real-Time Alerting rules, enabling monitoring at larger scale.
  • These capabilities apply to In-Progress Meetings and Calls rule types.

The feature is enabled by default when it becomes available in your tenant.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required.

We recommend that administrators:

  • Review existing Real-Time Alerting management processes.
  • Evaluate whether rule duplication and bulk user upload capabilities can simplify current administrative workflows.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced real-time alerting rule management in the Teams admin center
